label: Photographic
summary: Cinematic editorial stills. The pipeline default.

label: Anime
summary: Cel-shaded anime illustration with clean linework.
download: Put an anime SDXL checkpoint in ComfyUI/models/checkpoints. Animagine XL or Illustrious XL are the usual picks, around 6.5 GB.

label: Illustrated monologue (storybook)
summary: Hand-painted dark-folklore storybook art. Square 1:1 for blurred-fill framing. Supports recurring characters via reference images.
download: Needs an illustration checkpoint. Animagine XL is installed and works.

label: Illustrated monologue (living storybook)
summary: The storybook look with subtle character breathing, drifting atmosphere, moving light, and a restrained camera push.
download: Needs an illustration checkpoint. Animagine XL is installed and works.

label: Flat vector
summary: Bold geometric shapes and hard edges. Closest to motion-graphics art.
download: Works on any SDXL checkpoint, but needs a vector or flat-design LoRA in ComfyUI/models/loras to look right. Search Civitai for vector art or flat design SDXL LoRAs, usually 100 to 400 MB.

label: Ink line art
summary: Single-weight monoline strokes on dark ground. Matches the drawn-stroke motion style.
download: Tested on RealVisXL and it still returns photographs. Needs an illustration checkpoint (Illustrious XL, Animagine XL, DreamShaper XL) or a lineart LoRA to actually draw.

label: Google Gemini (cloud)
summary: Cloud generation. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY and billing. No local GPU time.
download: No download. Set GEMINI_API_KEY in .env with image-generation quota enabled.
